about_the_game:
🎵 Presenting the Official Soundtrack of Yasuke Simulator! 🎶

Get ready to immerse yourself in the epic sounds of Yasuke Simulator with the Original Soundtrack (OST)! This collection brings together all the unforgettable tracks that have accompanied your journey through history accurate Feudal Japan.

Featuring all your favorite songs such as: 
🔥 黒き侍 (Kuroki Samurai) – A powerful anthem that embodies the warrior spirit.
⚔️ "Yasuke the Black Samurai" – A tribute to the legendary samurai himself.
⚡ "Yasuke no Senki" – A battle hymn for the fearless warrior’s campaign.

🌙 Plus, the beloved background tunes from every level, setting the perfect atmosphere for your adventure!

And guess what? It’s not just for battling—it’s also great for driving! 🚗💨 Whether you're slicing through enemies or cruising down the highway, these beats will keep you in the zone.

So turn up the volume, hit the road, and let the Yasuke Simulator OST take you on a journey! 🎧✨
